facts.text: The resort sits amid 600 acres of oak-covered hills in the Texas Hill Country near San Antonio.
facts.excerpt: nestled amid 600 acres of oak-covered hills near downtown San Antonio, Texas Hill Country

facts.text: Resort guests have exclusive access to the River Bluff Water Experience, a nine-acre water park with water slides.
facts.excerpt: Resort guests have exclusive access to the River Bluff Water Experience at our hotel in North San Antonio, with a nine-acre water park and water slides.

facts.text: The water park includes an activity pool, waterfalls, a 1,100-foot lazy river and a 650-foot action river ride.
facts.excerpt: Endless adventure is found across an expansive activity pool, free-flowing waterfalls, a 1,100-foot lazy river and a 650-foot action river ride.

facts.text: The water park has an infinity pool for adults overlooking the Texas Hill Country.
facts.excerpt: relax in the adults-only infinity pool overlooking the Texas Hill Country

facts.text: The water park has a Sand Beach Pool where guests can build sandcastles.
facts.excerpt: building sandcastles at the Sand Beach Pool

facts.text: Guests climb the Water Tower next to the children's pool to reach the Acequia Tube Slides.
facts.excerpt: Guests can ascend the Water Tower adjacent to the children’s pool to access the Acequia Tube Slides

facts.text: TPC San Antonio has two 18-hole championship golf courses designed by Pete Dye and Greg Norman.
facts.excerpt: TPC San Antonio opened in January 2010 with two 18-hole championship golf courses designed by two of golf’s most innovative architects: Pete Dye and Greg Norman.

facts.text: The Oaks course has hosted the PGA Tour's Valero Texas Open since 2010.
facts.excerpt: The Oaks course serving as the host of the PGA Tour’s Valero Texas Open since 2010

facts.text: TPC San Antonio golf is open to resort guests and members.
facts.excerpt: TPC San Antonio is a private resort only accessible to guests of the JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa and Members

facts.text: Lantana Spa offers massage, beauty and wellness therapies inspired by the traditions of Latin American Curanderos.
facts.excerpt: Discover a full menu of massage, beauty, and wellness therapies embracing the spirit and traditions of Latin American Curanderos.

facts.text: Lantana Spa guests receive a red ribbon on arrival as part of the Seven Knots Ritual to release worries and stress.
facts.excerpt: Upon arrival, Lantana Spa guests are given a piece of red ribbon. Part of the Seven Knots Ritual to release worries and stress

facts.text: Lantana Spa has a private, lagoon-like pool, a spa cafe and a spa boutique.
facts.excerpt: guests can enjoy the peaceful serenity of the private, lagoon-like pool, healthy refreshments at our spa café and then shop at our spa boutique.

facts.text: Select rooms have private Juliet or walkout balconies with views of the rolling hills.
facts.excerpt: Select spaces offer private Juliet or walkout balconies with sweeping views of the rolling hills outside San Antonio.

facts.text: The Grand River Suites incorporate the style of the San Antonio haciendas that grew into Texas ranches.
facts.excerpt: The style of the San Antonio haciendas that later grew into the legendary Texas ranches has been incorporated into these expansive suites

facts.text: Each Grand River Suite has a fireplace, a library and a dining room that seats up to 8.
facts.excerpt: a dining room that seats up to 8, multiple 65” LCD HDTVs, a fireplace, a library, and a powder room

facts.text: The Golf View Suites have oversized balconies overlooking the TPC San Antonio golf courses.
facts.excerpt: oversized balconies overlooking the TPC San Antonio golf courses

facts.text: 18 Oaks is the resort's signature steakhouse, rooted in the flavors of Texas.
facts.excerpt: 18 Oaks, our hotel's signature steakhouse restaurant in North San Antonio, is steeped in the authentic flavors of Texas.

facts.text: Cibolo Moon has over 100 tequila varieties behind the bar.
facts.excerpt: Cibolo Moon features over 100 tequila varieties behind the bar

facts.text: The resort has a 5,000-square-foot organic garden.
facts.excerpt: The San Antonio water park hotel’s 5,000-square-foot organic garden contains tomatoes

facts.text: A self-guided art tour highlights artists of Texas and the wider United States.
facts.excerpt: this self-guided tour highlights incredible artists of Texas and the wider United States

facts.text: The resort has running and walking trails through its Hill Country surroundings.
facts.excerpt: Experience our resplendent Texas Hill Country surroundings on our running and walking trails.

facts.text: Natural Bridge Caverns, Six Flags Fiesta Texas and Texas wine country are within an hour's drive.
facts.excerpt: Natural Bridge Caverns, Six Flags Fiesta Texas, and the Lone Star State’s wine country are all within an hour drive.

facts.text: The resort is 14 miles northeast of San Antonio International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The resort is 14 miles NE of the airport

facts.text: Kid-friendly activities include scavenger hunts, arcade games and nightly s'mores.
facts.excerpt: includes scavenger hunts, arcade games, and nightly s’mores

facts.text: The resort opened on January 22, 2010.
facts.excerpt: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa opened on January 22, 2010.
